Leonardo's Guild: Waterwheel Quarter. Explore connected workshops, drying roofs and a working sluice, with desktop, first-person VR and AR/VR miniature views.

Learn the place.
Find your route.
Bring it home.

A commission is stranded above a shared waterworks. Help Marta repair the loading drive, cross Ilaria's drying roofs, or drain the service channel and follow its stairs. Discover how the households connect, open the familiar bell-bracket arch, and use that knowledge again on a finishing delivery. Fresh adventures start in the Waterwheel Quarter. Existing saves keep their older Vinci campaign: visit the Quarter entrance beside Leonardo's workshop on foot, near (-5, -6), and press X. Nothing you earned is reset.

Play on screen, enter first-person VR, or stand over the actual miniature in diorama VR or AR. Choose the XR presentation before entering. The top, front, or both can be open; the exhibit is never sealed. These new spatial views currently cover the Quarter. Older regions retain seated theatre.
Same single-player adventure and saved accomplishments. Quest and Xbox hardware playtesting remains open.
